Hi Sarah — I'd like to hold our CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). My own week is packed; the gaps I have are Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30.

Which of those work for you? If none does, tell me what does and I'll see what I can move. I'll keep it to 30 minutes.

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. Could you send me the official schedule for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27): lectures, seminars and university meetings? I'm fixing a slot for the CSE455 staff meeting and want to avoid clashing with anything on your books.

Hello Professor Alvarez — here is the official schedule for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), as it stands:

**Mon Nov 23**
- 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee (Prof. Alvarez)
- 13:00–14:00 Colloquium (Prof. Alvarez)
- 14:10–15:40 Seminar

**Tue Nov 24**

**Fri Nov 27**

- 12:30–13:20 Colloquium (Prof. Alvarez)
- 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)

- 14:50–15:50 Seminar

- 15:50–17:00 CSE444 lecture

Nothing has been cancelled or moved. Note that Wednesday morning is fully booked from 09:00 to 12:00, Tuesday afternoon likewise, and your Friday CSE455 lecture ends at 14:30.

Hi Professor — happy to meet. Looking at my week: Mon 10:00 and Mon 14:00 don't work (CSE452 lab, then seminar), and Tue 11:00 clashes with my seminar, but **Tue 15:00-15:30** is free — let's take that. Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 are taken by CSE455 office hours and my quiz section. So: Tuesday Nov 25, 15:00-15:30. I've put it in my calendar.

Thank you — exactly what I needed. Two points I want to be sure of before I fix a slot for the CSE455 staff meeting (30 minutes):

1. You note Wednesday morning is fully booked 09:00–12:00, but the items you list leave 10:00–10:30 open. Is that half hour free, or is something on it?
2. Monday you have a Seminar 14:10–15:40, which overlaps my CSE455 lecture 14:30–15:20 — is that right, or does that seminar not concern me?

Also, for my own record: the CSE455 office hours 15:30–16:20 and quiz section 16:20–17:00 on Tuesday, and the office hours 10:30–12:00 and quiz section 13:30–14:20 on Wednesday, are not in my calendar — are those mine or my TAs'?

Update, Sarah — the department just sent me the official schedule, and two of the slots I offered are out: Mon 14:00–14:30 clashes with the seminar, and Tue 11:00–11:30 runs into it as well.

The clean 30-minute gaps for next week are:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

Pick whichever suits you and I'll book it.

Thanks — that matches what I had. Of your four, only **Tue 15:00-15:30** works for me: Mon 10:00 is my CSE452 lab slot, Wed 10:00 is CSE455 office hours and Wed 13:00 is the quiz section. So let's keep **Tuesday Nov 25, 15:00-15:30** — it's already on my calendar. Nothing further needed from you.

You're right to check — my note about Wednesday was imprecise, apologies.

1. Wednesday morning: the listed items are 09:00–10:00 and 10:30–12:00, so on the official schedule 10:00–10:30 is empty.
2. Monday: yes, the schedule lists Seminar 14:10–15:40 and CSE455 lecture 14:30–15:20, so they do overlap on paper. I can't say who should attend the seminar; I only have the list as it stands.

On the office hours and quiz sections: the schedule only marks items as yours where it says "(Professor Alvarez)". The Tuesday 15:30–16:20 office hours, the Tuesday 16:20–17:00 quiz section, the Wednesday 10:30–12:00 office hours and the Wednesday 13:30–14:20 quiz section carry no name, so I can't tell you whether they are yours or your TAs'.

Booked: CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30. (You wrote Nov 25 — next week's Tuesday is the 24th; tell me if you meant the Wednesday, though that one is tight for me.) It's in my calendar and logged. See you then.

Understood, thank you — no apology needed. For the record: I've booked the CSE455 staff meeting for Tuesday 15:00–15:30, which is clear on your schedule. I'll keep Wed 10:00–10:30 in mind as a spare. If you ever learn who owns those unmarked office hours and quiz sections, I'd be glad to know.
Noted: CSE455 staff meeting Tue 15:00–15:30, and Wed 10:00–10:30 as a spare. If I learn who the unmarked office hours and quiz sections belong to, I'll let you know.
You're right, my mistake — Tuesday is Nov 24, not the 25th. Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30 is what I meant, so we're aligned. See you then.
